content.text: Download the appAboutCricket live score service at Sofascore livescore allows you to follow real time cricket results, standings and fixtures. Live matches from cricket leagues has ball by ball coverage for every inning and detailed tables for fall of the wicket and partnership. All of that is available for the most popular leagues and cups: Indian Premier League, Champions League Twenty20, Big Bash League, Caribbean Premier League, Friends Life T20 and for ICC Cricket World Cup 2015. All scores on Sofascore are automatically updated and there is no need to refresh it manually.
